summary: Defines a set of SNMP managed objects for monitoring and configuring traffic engineering in MPLS networks, such as the tunnels operators set up to steer traffic along chosen paths. It lets standard network management tools read and manage this state in a uniform way.

eli5.summary: Imagine a control panel with labeled dials for a network's special reserved roads. This document says what the dials are called, so any manager's tools can read them.
